configuration.sampling: 128 Kaggle + 128 camera each batch, with replacement; Kaggle class uniform then image uniform; camera class uniform then clip uniform then valid frame uniform
configuration.selection: combined 24-class macro clip accuracy; strict improvement over epoch 0 required; ties among improved candidates use lower macro clip NLL
configuration.aggregation: mean valid-frame probabilities over all 24 classes

duplicate_check_scope: exact complete valid landmark/feature sequences, independent of metadata; not a guarantee against near-duplicate performances
